title: TS-29 Computer record, actions, lookup-or-park
description:
## Slice 2 ticket 29 of 40, phase notes: paths use `conversation/` (the workspace as it is on develop). Design source: `git show origin/docs/typescript-control-plane:docs/TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE.md` (section 8, row 29); read sections 0.3, 2, 3 and 6 as needed. Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md first. Never read or write `project/`; use `kbs` only.

## Goal
Implement the computer record and the durable computer action, the Pi computer tools that look up or park, the executor park path and the resume path. This is the most uncertain Pi integration, so a prototype comes first.

## Kind
prototype-first: a library API in this ticket is uncertain. A Sonnet agent must FIRST produce verified, runnable code for it (see Prototype section), paste it into this ticket as a comment, and ONLY THEN is the ticket completed with that code verbatim. A Haiku implementer must not start the build part until that comment exists; if it is missing, stop and report.

## Branch and commit
```text
git fetch origin
git switch -c ts/29-computer-record-actions-lookup-or-park origin/develop
...work, then...
git add <only the files listed under Files>
git commit -m "feat(conversation): computer record, actions, lookup-or-park

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git push -u origin ts/29-computer-record-actions-lookup-or-park
```
Do NOT open a pull request; the orchestrator opens it. Commit messages contain no emojis.

## Files to create or change
- `conversation/src/domain/computers.ts`
- `conversation/src/domain/actions.ts`
- `conversation/src/pi/computer-tools.ts`
- `conversation/src/turn/park.ts`
- `conversation/features-support/steps/computer.steps.ts`
- `conversation/features-support/steps/action.steps.ts`
- `features/computer_action_handoff.feature`

## Exported interface and error behavior
Action items: pk `{t}#computer#actions` sk `act#{action_id}` and index pk `{t}#turn#{id}` sk `act#{call_id}`. Tools `read_workspace`, `write_workspace`, `run_terminal`, `browse`, `request_computer_capability` declared `replay: "safe"` with execute = lookup-or-park (section 4.4 pseudocode). On park the executor sets `waiting_for`, appends `turn.waiting`, enqueues ComputerStartJobs when no live host, releases the claim and closes the harness WITHOUT abort.

General rules: TypeScript ESM, `.ts` import suffixes as in conversation/src/storage/; tabs for indentation as in existing files; long clear names; no line comments; TSDoc on exported symbols; no emojis. Each Python exception class used by a ported function becomes an exported `Error` subclass with the same name and the same message text. Failures are thrown, never returned as magic values, unless the Python returned them.

## Prototype (must be done and pasted before the build)
A Sonnet agent starts from spikes/pi-durable-6c4d24 handoff code (read its README) and proves with vitest on moto: a tool `execute` that parks (never settles), the harness closed without abort, a second owner with a new fence reopening the session and the same tool call resuming with a recorded result found by call id. Verified code is pasted into the ticket and used verbatim.

## Behavior spec (Gherkin, ported unchanged)
Existing features that must pass under cucumber-js when this ticket closes. Do NOT edit these `.feature` files except where this ticket says a behavior changed.
